name: Will a home extension increase property value in the Los Angeles area?

mainEntity.name: Will a home extension increase property value in the Los Angeles area?
mainEntity.text: Will a home extension increase property value in the Los Angeles area?

acceptedAnswer.text: A home extension can improve resale value, but the return depends on what you build and how well it fits the neighborhood. In many Los Angeles markets, buyers pay a premium for functional square footage, especially when it creates a new bedroom, bathroom, primary suite, or larger living area. However, adding too much space or finishing a home at a level far above surrounding properties may not fully return the cost. Layout matters too: a poorly planned addition can increase square footage without making the home more livable. The best value usually comes from additions that solve a real need, improve flow, and use quality materials without overspending on features the market will not reward. Homeowners should look at local comps, the lot’s development potential, and whether the addition improves day-to-day use as well as resale appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: A well-designed home extension can increase value, especially when it adds a bedroom, bathroom, primary suite, or better indoor-outdoor flow. The return is usually strongest when the addition matches the neighborhood and does not overbuild for the area.
